caption: The drawing depicts two primary objects placed on a plain, light beige or off-white background. In the upper left quadrant, there is a pair of eyeglasses with thin, gold-colored metal frames and rectangular lenses, positioned with the arms extended and slightly open. Below and slightly to the right of the eyeglasses, there is a single eyeglass case, cylindrical in shape and partially open at one end. The case is colored with various shades of brown and black, giving it a textured, worn appearance. The objects are isolated from one another, and the composition is sparse, with ample empty space surrounding them. There is a small, neat signature by the artist in the lower left corner, and faint handwritten text near the bottom edge of the paper.
title: Spectacles and Case
